summary: The October 9 update preloads Season 9, which officially begins on October 23 alongside the new Magichess season, Realm of Strife. A long-awaited Server Transfer Pre-registration system is being introduced, allowing players to transfer servers during seasonal settlement with a target server invitation code and approval. Glory Colosseum returns on December 1 as a revamped monthly 3-team server-wide PvP mode with refreshed battle mechanics and rewards. Additional QoL updates include auto-processing custom equipment settings, quick-leveling features for the Legacy Coffer, and Magichess talent rebalances.
meta_changes: Server Transfer Pre-registration added, allowing server changes during seasonal settlement under target server approval.
Glory Colosseum returns December 1 as a revamped server-wide 3-team PvP competitive mode.
Magichess updates include the new Conqueror bond, three upcoming heroes, talent rebalances (Bounty and Alchemy), and additional Tactical Adventure stages.
tips: Avoid blindly transferring servers thinking it will be easier, as many competitive players will be attempting the same move.
Ensure you obtain an invitation code from the target server before submitting a server transfer reservation.
Server transfers can only be executed during your current server's seasonal settlement period.
